email_subject: Application - GTM Executive at All Sport
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the GTM Executive role at All Sport. With a background in digital marketing, web coordination, and project support, I am drawn to the opportunity to help execute seasonal Go-To-Market processes for the Nike Equipment business.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I manage multiple client projects simultaneously, coordinating content, CMS updates, and SEO deliverables against tight deadlines. I build and maintain websites, manage product catalogues on Shopify and WooCommerce, and ensure data accuracy across platforms. My experience with WordPress, Excel, and cross-functional collaboration has sharpened my attention to detail and ability to keep stakeholders aligned.

I am fluent in English, highly organized, and comfortable supporting leadership with meeting preparation and follow-up. I would welcome the chance to bring my execution discipline and collaborative mindset to All Sport's international team.

Thank you for your consideration.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the GTM Executive position at All Sport. Your focus on building long-term local relationships and executing seasonal launches with precision resonates with my own approach to project coordination and commercial support. With a background in digital marketing and web management, I have developed strong organizational skills and a keen eye for detail that I believe align well with the demands of this role.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing positions, I manage multiple client projects simultaneously, from website builds to content calendars and SEO audits. I coordinate deliverables across teams, maintain product catalogues on Shopify and WooCommerce, and ensure data accuracy in CMS platforms like WordPress. My experience with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams has been central to tracking progress, preparing reports, and communicating with stakeholders. I have also supported event coordination and meeting logistics for client projects, ensuring action items are documented and followed up.

What draws me to All Sport is the opportunity to work within a family-owned business that values passion, people, and entrepreneurial spirit. I am eager to contribute to the Nike Equipment GTM process, helping to keep seasonal milestones on track and cross-functional teams aligned. My technical background and experience with B2B platforms would enable me to quickly grasp the tools and systems central to this role.

I am fluent in English and comfortable working in fast-paced international environments. I would welcome the chance to discuss how my execution discipline and collaborative mindset can support the Brand Director and the wider team.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
